Criteria: Singapore only; EXPLICIT March 2027 start stated on the listing; 4-6 months; Business / Strategy / Data / Tech / Finance / AI; no natural-science/lab roles; genuine internship (not grad job); listing open.
Tab 1 - Explicit March 2027: 10 open matches verified on the actual listing page.
Tab 2 - Leads (confirm March): 13 roles where March is plausible but NOT explicitly stated (Spring/H1 2027, off-cycle, or no start month). Confirm start month before applying.
Tab 3 - Closed or rejected: 87 records: closed listings, wrong start month, wrong duration, grad jobs, or science roles. Kept for audit.
Key flags: KPMG (both) + CapitaLand are polytechnic/diploma-labelled - confirm university-degree eligibility. Cynapse ML is engineering-heavy (Python/PyTorch/Linux). RCL Feeder roles close 29 Nov 2026.
Pay: UNRDD' = undisclosed on the listing; no numbers invented.
Method: 3 parallel search sweeps (finance / tech / business) + targeted verification. Sources: company career portals (Workday/Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby/SmartRecruiters), MyCareersFuture, InternSG, eFinancialCareers, LinkedIn.
